scope: Final findings comprise citation quote literals and two copies of the documented Bhumi API route in the bhumi_backend_proxy rationale. These are source literals, not structured file references; the genuine failing tool result is retained.

manifestNormalization.reason: Graphify 0.17.1 Windows manifest writer emits absolute Windows keys and retains old still-existing entries.
manifestNormalization.normalization: Only manifest metadata was regenerated from actual detected files with relative keys and the same mtime/MD5 schema; graph, ontology and Studio data were produced by Graphify commands.

provenance.freshness: Base is pre-commit HEAD; tracked scope includes staged source. Compare manifest hashes after the containing commit.
provenance.descriptionGrounding: Descriptions use source locations, symbol/neighborhood context, rationale and citations when present. A description is not proof of citation coverage.
provenance.assistantTokenCounters: Unmetered zero placeholders, not evidence of zero assistant usage.
provenance.reportCapture: Portable report captured outside scan inputs before copying here; earlier report archived outside publication to avoid recursion.

viewer.limitation: Root browser smoke confirmed the served index.html displays the Tanya description with correct source, community and four relations. The legacy scene-only offline studio.html omits description data and did not display it. No renderer or runtime code was patched.

decision: Structured source references and manifest hashes are checked independently. Retain the actual portability exit status and findings; this review does not turn a failing tool result into a pass.
